svg.title: Scenario 6: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Potion to Heal

g.text: Scenario 6: Player Turn — Warrior Uses Potion to Heal
Scenarios 6 and 7 occur in the same executePlayerTurn() call.
Warrior (SPD=30) acts first → uses Potion. DefendBuff expires here (turns=1→0).
Goblin (SPD=25) acts second → still stunned, skips again (Scenario 7).
is shown listing the player's inventory.
User picks Potion from inventory list.
GameApp resolves itemIndex → actual Item object
from the Player's live inventory list.
Goblin phase follows next in this same call.
Goblin is still stunned — see Scenario 7 for detail.
[TurnFrame("Warrior uses Potion."), TurnFrame(Goblin stunned — no attack)]
